# Compare And Improve Mattress SEO Pages

Inspect current live SERPs and relevant accessible competitors. Identify rewarded page types, query intent, titles, headings, decision support, product presentation, internal links, schema/canonicals, and affiliate journey. Confirm whether the correct Mattress URL owns the query, including whether an evidenced guide, comparison, or product review is missing. If SERPs are blocked, use an approved accessible alternative; if external evidence is unavailable, say so.

Check catalogue, scoring, affiliate, and UK/US evidence before mentioning product attributes, availability, prices, trials, delivery, returns, or guarantees. Do not make medical claims or treat general shopping support as clinical advice. Return exact proposed wording and placement plus the smallest bounded technical/content change. Stop for approval before implementation.
